title: Tai Tam Upper Reservoir Dam

terrainReference.basis: Original Lands Department terrain on the mapped dam crest near the midpoint.

mapIdentity.provider: OpenStreetMap native Upper Reservoir structure and shoreline
mapIdentity.scope: Mapped dam way 448005771 and its shared upstream shoreline with the named Upper Reservoir. The crest and outer shoulders use documented and mapped extents.

note: Granite-faced concrete gravity section with upper narrowing, rough stone courses, dressed coping and double-bar railing. The original independent terrain establishes the toe and reveals the 30 m central relief.
